12 countries: no clearance without the Ministry's approval (5 November 2026)

facts.c: The Embassy said Cambodia would show leniency until 30 April 2026 to foreigners staying irregularly, especially those working in online scam centres, before taking legal action after that date
facts.q: কম্বোডিয়ান সরকার আগামী বৃহস্পতিবার ৩০ এপ্রিল ২০২৬ তারিখ পর্যন্ত সেদেশে অনিয়মিতভাবে অবস্থানরত বিদেশি নাগরিকদের

facts.c: The Bangladesh Embassy in Bangkok held a consular camp in Phnom Penh on 4-5 April 2026 and issued more than a hundred Travel Passes there
facts.q: গত ৪-৫ এপ্রিল ২০২৬ তারিখে নমপেনে দূতাবাস কর্তৃক পরিচালিত কনস্যুলার ক্যাম্পের মাধ্যমে শতাধিক ট্রাভেল পাশ ইস্যু করা হয়েছে

facts.c: Some people stayed on after their Travel Pass expired or tried to cross into neighbouring countries on others' advice, raising their risk of jail and fines
facts.q: ট্রাভেল পাশের মেয়াদ উত্তীর্ণ হওয়ার পরও সংশ্লিষ্ট ব্যক্তিগণ দেশের ফেরার উদ্যোগ না নিয়ে

facts.c: Applications for a Travel Pass or a fine waiver go by email to mission.bangkok@mofa.gov.bd or fsbangkok@probashi.gov.bd, or as a hard copy to the Embassy in Bangkok
facts.q: ইমেইলের mission.bangkok@mofa.gov.bd, fsbangkok@probashi.gov.bd মাধ্যমে অথবা বাংলাদেশ দূতাবাস, ব্যাংককের ঠিকানায় হার্ডকপিতে আবেদন প্রেরণ করতে হবে

facts.c: A Travel Pass application needs a passport copy, NID, police clearance, a photo and details of where the applicant now is
facts.q: পাসপোর্টের কপি, জাতীয় পরিচয়পত্র, পুলিশ ক্লিয়ারেন্স, ছবি এবং বর্তমান অবস্থানের বিস্তারিত তথ্য সংযুক্ত হবে

facts.c: An overstay-fine waiver application needs copies of the passport and visa
facts.q: ওভারস্টে জরিমানা মওকুফের জন্য পাসপোর্ট ও ভিসার কপি সংযুক্ত করতে হবে

facts.c: Bangladesh has an Honorary Consul in Cambodia, Oknha Sreat Mom Sophear
facts.q: SREAT Mom Sophear had been appointed as the Honorary Consul of the People's Republic of Bangladesh in the Kingdom of Cambodia

facts.c: On 5 May 2026 the Honorary Consulate said overstay-fine waiver applications had been completed for about 1,500-1,600 stranded Bangladeshis
facts.q: the visa overstay waiver application process has successfully been completed for approximately 1,500–1,600 Bangladeshi citizens who were stranded in Cambodia

facts.c: On 5 May 2026 the new waiver application process was partially closed; people needing urgent help can contact the Honorary Consulate or the Embassy in Bangkok
facts.q: At present, the new application process has been partially closed.

facts.c: The Honorary Consulate's liaison officer Md Zahid Hasan (Rafique) can be reached on mobile and WhatsApp at +855 96 245 30 84
facts.q: Mobile/WhatsApp: +855 96 245 30 84

facts.c: The Honorary Consulate's liaison office is at No. 216B, Street 63 (Trasak Pa-em), Sangkat Boeung Keng Kang 1, Phnom Penh; email rafique@bangladeshhc-cambodia.com
facts.q: Address: No. 216B, Street 63 (Trasak Pa-em), Sangkat Boueng Keng Kang 1, Phnom Penh, Kingdom of Cambodia

facts.c: Waiver lists were sent to Cambodia's Foreign Ministry; once approved, applicants go to the Phnom Penh immigration office with their documents within 2-3 weeks
facts.q: Upon approval, you may contact Phnom Penh Immigration Office with the necessary documents within 2–3 weeks.

facts.c: New waiver applications go with passport and visa copies by email to sophear@sophiyacorp.com or to the Embassy in Bangkok (mission.bangkok@mofa.gov.bd, fsbangkok@probashi.gov.bd)
facts.q: please send your passport and visa copies via email to sophear@sophiyacorp.com

facts.c: Cambodia's visa exemption list of 20 October 2026 gives Bangladesh 30 days for diplomatic and official passports and no exemption for ordinary passports, so ordinary Bangladeshi passport holders need a visa
facts.q: Row 12: Bangladesh | Diplomatic: 30 days | Official: 30 days | Special: (blank) | Ordinary: (blank)
v: visa exemption for ordinary Bangladeshi passports

facts.c: MFAIC's fee table (Joint Ministerial Order No. 1039 of 21 September 2016) sets the e-visa at USD 36, issued within 1 day, valid 3 months
facts.q: 1 | E-visa | 36 $ | 1 day | 3 months
facts.note: Fee order dated 2016; page shown on the MFAIC site in 2026

facts.c: At Cambodian embassies abroad a business (E) visa costs USD 35 and is valid 3 months, issued within 3 days
facts.q: 1.5 | Visa type E (Business) | 35 $ | 3 days | 3 months

facts.c: At Cambodian embassies abroad a tourist (T) visa costs USD 30 and is valid 3 months
facts.q: 1.11 | Visa type T (Tourist) | 30 $ | 3 days | 3 months

facts.c: Multiple-entry business visas at Cambodian embassies cost USD 50 (1 year), USD 75 (2 years) and USD 100 (3 years)
facts.q: 1.6 | Visa type E1 (Business Multiple with 1 year validity) | 50 $ | 3 days | 1 year
facts.note: E2 USD 75 and E3 USD 100 are on the next lines of the same table

facts.c: Rising BD lists Cambodia among the 12 countries for which the Ministry's letter of 4 November 2026 bars BMET clearance without Ministry approval
facts.q: সার্বিয়া, মলদোভা, বেলারুশ, কঙ্গো, রাশিয়া, জাপান, ইরাক, লাওস, ভিয়েতনাম, কম্বোডিয়া, ইউক্রেন ও লিবিয়া

facts.c: The Ministry's letter gives no reason for the new instruction
facts.q: নির্দেশনা দেওয়ার কারণ সম্পর্কে মন্ত্রণালয়ের চিঠিতে কিছু উল্লেখ করা হয়নি
